technical_and_design_decisions: Target modules ported from Spring XD (U1-U5) will be refactored into Spring Cloud Stream standalone processor applications/components utilizing standard Spring Integration and Spring Cloud Stream annotations.
The 'script' processor (U3) will leverage JSR-223 / Spring Integration Scripting support for dynamic evaluation (e.g., Groovy, JavaScript).
The 'shell' processor (U4) will implement robust process execution management, handling standard input/output streaming, error redirection, and timeout configurations.

The 'BinderFactory' abstraction (U8) will define a SPI and dynamic ApplicationContext loading mechanism allowing runtime selection and instantiation of multiple messaging binder types (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ) within a single application context.

The exploration tasks for composed jobs (U6, U7) will be conducted as technical spikes resulting in architecture decision records (ADRs), resource cleanup strategies, and ZooKeeper metadata path/schema specifications.
assumptions: The developer has full access to both Spring XD and Spring Cloud Stream source repositories.
Development and testing will be performed in a single-developer environment using JDK 17+ and standard Spring Boot test tools.
Integration tests for binders and processor modules will rely on embedded messaging implementations or Testcontainers.
Effort estimates represent pure development workdays (8 hours/day) excluding external review delays.

activities.activity_description: Analyze existing Spring XD module implementations, set up local build environment, and establish module templates for spring-cloud-stream (s-c-s) processors.
Port the json-to-tuple conversion logic from Spring XD to s-c-s, create auto-configuration properties, and add unit and integration tests.
Port the object-to-json transformer module from Spring XD to s-c-s, implement message payload conversion, and provide test coverage.
Port script processor module supporting dynamic script execution (Groovy/JSR-223) within s-c-s pipeline, including resource loading and unit/integration tests.
Port shell command execution module, handling external process invocation, argument passing, stream management, process timeouts, and tests.
Port payload and expression-based splitter processor from Spring XD to s-c-s, including SpEL support and split collection streaming tests.

activities.activity_name: Technical Spike: Composed Job Removal Options (U6)
activities.activity_description: Investigate mechanisms in Spring XD to clean up unused memory footprints and resources associated with composed jobs; document recommendations and draft implementation options.

activities.activity_name: Technical Spike: Composed Job Definition in ZK Metadata (U7)
activities.activity_description: Explore strategies for persisting composed job definitions into ZooKeeper metadata store for state recovery during failure scenarios; construct POC and document schema/path structure.
Design and implement the BinderFactory interface and default registry in Spring Cloud Stream to enable runtime dynamic creation and lookup of multiple binder types.
Refactor context loading to utilize BinderFactory, add configuration handling for multi-binder setups, and implement end-to-end integration tests.
Update project documentation, build scripts, configuration samples, and run full suite regression verification across all new modules and features.
